SETINV-pos1.label: violation
SETINV-pos1.note: The blast service adds up the month's planned blasts and throws when the new blast would pass the bench permit; the Bench no longer checks it.

SETINV-pos2.label: violation
SETINV-pos2.note: The blast controller asks the service for the permit and the tonnes already planned and refuses the request itself; the service and the Bench plan the blast without the check.

SETINV-pos3.label: violation
SETINV-pos3.note: The in-memory blast repository refuses to save a blast that would take its bench over the monthly permit; the Bench no longer checks it.

SETINV-pos4.label: violation
SETINV-pos4.note: The haul service works out the shift total in a local variable and returns a refusal result when the load would pass the truck's allowance; the Truck no longer checks it.

SETINV-pos5.label: violation
SETINV-pos5.note: The Haul aggregate's factory takes the shift's hauls and the truck's allowance and refuses an over-allowance load; the owner Truck no longer checks it.

SETINV-pos6.label: violation
SETINV-pos6.note: A payload policy in src/haulage/domain/policies/, outside the Truck aggregate's module, checks the shift allowance and the service calls it; the Truck no longer checks it.

SETINV-twin1.label: clean
SETINV-twin1.note: A new re-plan feature: the service hands the month's blasts to the Bench, which checks the permit before the blast's tonnes change.

SETINV-twin2.label: clean
SETINV-twin2.note: The haul service rejects a weighing with no positive net load and a shift date that is not a calendar date, before the Truck checks its allowance; neither is a declared invariant.

SETINV-twin3.label: clean
SETINV-twin3.note: The haul store refuses a second haul with the same weighbridge ticket; haul-ticket-unique is a uniqueness invariant the spec leaves to the store.

SETINV-twin4.label: clean
SETINV-twin4.note: A customer may drop an order line; QuarryOrder itself refuses to drop the last one, the single invariant order-has-lines.

SETINV-twin5.label: clean
SETINV-twin5.note: The blast controller shows the permit tonnes left for a month; the Bench works the figure out from the blasts the service hands it, and nothing is refused outside the Bench.

SETINV-twin6.label: clean
SETINV-twin6.note: The haul store sums the shift's tonnes in one query and the service hands that total to the Truck, which still compares it with the allowance and decides.
